items.jp: 君はこの券で無料で食事ができる。

translation.pt-BR: Com esse cupom você come de graça.
translation.en: This ticket entitles you to a free meal.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marca 食事 como o sujeito de できる, isto é, quem faz ou de quem se diz o que o predicado exprime.

items.jp: 金より銀の指輪の方が好きです。

translation.pt-BR: Eu gosto mais de anel de prata do que de ouro.
translation.en: I prefer silver rings to gold ones.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marca 方 como o sujeito de 好き, isto é, quem faz ou de quem se diz o que o predicado exprime.

items.jp: 荷物を預けることができますか。

translation.pt-BR: Posso despachar a bagagem?
translation.en: Could I check my bags?

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marca 預けること como o sujeito de できる, isto é, quem faz ou de quem se diz o que o predicado exprime.

items.jp: 遠くに塔が見えた。

translation.pt-BR: Dava para ver uma torre ao longe.
translation.en: We saw the tower in the distance.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marca 塔 como o sujeito de 見える, isto é, quem faz ou de quem se diz o que o predicado exprime.

items.jp: ここから波の音が聞こえる。

translation.pt-BR: Daqui dá para ouvir o barulho das ondas.
translation.en: The sea can be heard from here.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marca 音 como o sujeito de 聞こえる, isto é, quem faz ou de quem se diz o que o predicado exprime.

items.jp: 陸が見えてきた。

translation.pt-BR: A terra firme começou a aparecer.
translation.en: Land came in sight.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marca 陸 como o sujeito de 見える, isto é, quem faz ou de quem se diz o que o predicado exprime.

items.jp: 恋がしたい。

translation.pt-BR: Queria me apaixonar.
translation.en: I want to love.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marca 恋 como o sujeito de する, isto é, quem faz ou de quem se diz o que o predicado exprime.

items.jp: 知らぬが仏。

translation.pt-BR: O que os olhos não veem, o coração não sente.
translation.en: Ignorance is bliss.

items.label: partícula de sujeito (uso clássico)
items.explanation: が marca 知らぬ, 'quem não sabe', como sujeito do ditado: é essa pessoa que a frase chama de 仏. Aqui が não é o 'mas'.

items.jp: 荷物を預かって欲しいのですが。

translation.pt-BR: Vocês podem guardar minha bagagem?
translation.en: Would you keep this baggage, please?

items.label: conjunção adversativa ('mas')
items.explanation: が no fim, depois de のです, não marca sujeito: é o 'mas' que deixa a frase em aberto. Quem ouve completa o pedido (será que dá?), e isso soa mais educado.

items.jp: 外に出る前に帽子を被ってください

translation.pt-BR: Antes de sair, coloque o chapéu, por favor.
translation.en: Before you go out, please put on your hat.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 被っ to ください forming the request 〜てください ('please do').

items.jp: 切符をなくしてしまった

translation.pt-BR: Acabei perdendo o bilhete.
translation.en: I ended up losing the ticket.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the main verb なくす to the auxiliary しまう, forming the construction 〜てしまう.

items.jp: 母が朝から洗濯をしている

translation.pt-BR: Minha mãe está lavando roupa desde a manhã.
translation.en: My mom has been doing the laundry since this morning.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb し to いる, forming the progressive aspect している ('is doing').

items.jp: このシャツは木綿でできている

translation.pt-BR: Esta camisa é feita de algodão.
translation.en: This shirt is made of cotton.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links でき to いる to form the construction できている, which expresses a state.

items.jp: 服に犬の毛がついている

translation.pt-BR: Tem pelo de cachorro grudado na roupa.
translation.en: There's dog hair stuck to my clothes.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links ついて to the auxiliary いる, forming ている which expresses a continuous state.

items.jp: 彼女は指に小さな指輪をしている

translation.pt-BR: Ela está usando um anelzinho no dedo.
translation.en: She's wearing a little ring on her finger.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb し to the auxiliary いる, forming している, which expresses continuous action/state.

items.jp: 学生に毎日復習するようにしてほしい

translation.pt-BR: Eu quero que os alunos passem a revisar todo dia.
translation.en: I want the students to start reviewing every day.

items.label: conjunctive particle て
items.explanation: The て links する to ほしい, forming the pattern してほしい ('I want (someone) to do'); it is the て that allows ほしい to attach to the verb.
tokens: target of the request (the one you want to do it)
object/verbal noun (forms the clause with する)
verb of the target clause (復習する = to review)
core of the expression ように (purpose/goal)
auxiliary that forms ように with よう
main verb (する of してほしい)
desiderative auxiliary (ほしい after the て form)

items.jp: この国は石油を輸入しています

translation.pt-BR: Este país importa petróleo.
translation.en: This country imports oil.

items.label: verb connector (て-form)
items.explanation: て links し (of する) to the auxiliary いる, forming 〜ています (continuous/habitual action).

items.jp: やかんでお湯を沸かしている

translation.pt-BR: Estou esquentando água na chaleira.
translation.en: I'm heating water in the kettle.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 沸かす to the auxiliary いる to form the progressive aspect 〜ている.

items.jp: 試験に合格するように祈ってください

translation.pt-BR: Reze para que eu passe na prova.
translation.en: Pray that I pass the exam.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 祈って to the auxiliary ください, forming the polite request 〜てください ('please pray').

items.jp: 字が細かくて読めない

translation.pt-BR: A letra é tão pequena que não dá pra ler.
translation.en: The letters are so small I can't read them.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: This て is the ending of the て-form of the adjective 細かい (細かく+て). It chains the previous clause as the cause/reason for what comes after ('it is so tiny that...').

items.jp: 御連絡をお待ちしています

translation.pt-BR: Ficamos no aguardo do seu contato.
translation.en: We look forward to hearing from you.

items.label: conjunctive particle (て)
items.explanation: Links the verb し (する) to the auxiliary いる to form the progressive ています ('to be doing').
tokens: auxiliary (the verb する of the お〜する construction)

items.jp: 卵が三つ残っている

translation.pt-BR: Restam três ovos.
translation.en: There are three eggs left.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 残る to the auxiliary いる, forming 〜ている, which expresses a continuous/resultant state.

items.jp: 大学で法律を勉強しています

translation.pt-BR: Estudo direito na universidade.
translation.en: I study law at university.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb し to the auxiliary いる to form the continuous structure 〜ている.
tokens: object (verbal noun of 勉強する)

items.jp: 二つの店が競争している

translation.pt-BR: As duas lojas estão competindo entre si.
translation.en: The two stores are competing with each other.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 競争し to いる to build the continuous aspect 〜ている (to be competing).
tokens: nominal head of the compound verb

items.jp: ポケットから財布を出して

translation.pt-BR: Tira a carteira do bolso.
translation.en: Take the wallet out of your pocket.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て ends the verb in the て-form, which on its own serves as an informal request ('take it out', a short version of 出してください).

items.jp: 冷蔵庫にビールが冷やしてある

translation.pt-BR: Tem cerveja gelando na geladeira.
translation.en: There's beer chilling in the fridge.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 冷やす to ある, forming the structure 〜てある of the state that remains.
tokens: subject (thing that is in the resulting state)
main verb in the て form

items.jp: 部屋を片付けてください

translation.pt-BR: Arrume o quarto, por favor.
translation.en: Please tidy up the room.

items.label: connective particle て
items.explanation: Links the verb 片付ける to ください, forming the polite request 〜てください. Without it there would be no request.

items.jp: 部屋の電灯をつけてください

translation.pt-BR: Por favor, acenda a luz do quarto.
translation.en: Please turn on the light in the room.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb つける to ください, forming the polite request 〜てください ("please turn it on").

items.jp: 黄色いシャツを着ています

translation.pt-BR: Estou usando uma camisa amarela.
translation.en: I'm wearing a yellow shirt.

items.label: connective particle of the て-form
items.explanation: て links the verb 着 to the auxiliary いる, creating the continuous form 着ている.

items.jp: 二階の会議室に来てください

translation.pt-BR: Por favor, venha para a sala de reuniões do segundo andar.
translation.en: Please come to the meeting room on the second floor.

items.label: conjunctive particle of the て form
items.explanation: Links the verb 来る to ください; the form 〜て + ください builds the polite request 'please come'.

items.jp: 昔ここに城があったと考えられている

translation.pt-BR: Acredita-se que antigamente havia um castelo aqui.
translation.en: It's believed that there was a castle here long ago.

items.label: connective particle て
items.explanation: Links 考えられ to the auxiliary いる, forming 考えられている ('it is believed / it is thought').

items.jp: おちた紙を拾ってください

translation.pt-BR: Pega o papel que caiu, por favor.
translation.en: Please pick up the paper that fell.

items.label: conjunctive particle (〜て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 拾う to ください, forming the polite request 〜てください ('please pick up').
tokens: verb in a relative clause (modifies 紙)
direct object (head of the relative clause)

items.jp: その件はもう承知しています

translation.pt-BR: Sobre esse assunto, eu já estou ciente.
translation.en: As for that matter, I'm already aware of it.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links 承知し to the auxiliary いる, forming 承知している ('to be aware'); it is the て that allows expressing continuous/stative aspect with いる.
tokens: determiner (連体詞) that modifies 件

items.jp: いい店を紹介してください

translation.pt-BR: Me recomenda uma boa loja, por favor.
translation.en: Please recommend me a good store.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 紹介する to ください, forming the request construction 〜てください ('please do...').
tokens: nominal stem of the compound verb

items.jp: シャツのボタンを取り替えてもらった

translation.pt-BR: Mandei trocar o botão da camisa.
translation.en: I had the button on my shirt replaced.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 取り替え to the auxiliary もらう, forming 〜てもらう ('to receive the favor of someone doing something').

items.jp: 卵が二つ残っています

translation.pt-BR: Sobraram dois ovos.
translation.en: Two eggs are left over.

items.label: connective particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links 残っ to the auxiliary いる, forming the construction 〜ている which expresses a continuous/resultant state.

items.jp: 手の裏を見せてください

translation.pt-BR: Mostre as costas da mão, por favor.
translation.en: Please show me the back of your hand.

items.label: connective particle of the て-form (て)
items.explanation: Turns 見せる into 見せて, linking the verb to ください to build the request 'please show'.

items.jp: 葡萄は甘くておいしいです

translation.pt-BR: A uva é doce e gostosa.
translation.en: Grapes are sweet and delicious.

items.label: conjunction between adjectives
items.explanation: て (from 甘く + て) joins two い-adjectives in a list of qualities: 'sweet and tasty'.

items.jp: 急に曇ってきました

translation.pt-BR: De repente o tempo fechou.
translation.en: It suddenly clouded over.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 曇る to the auxiliary verb くる, forming the pattern 〜てくる of a change approaching the present.

items.jp: 弟は毎週柔道を習っている

translation.pt-BR: Meu irmão mais novo faz judô toda semana.
translation.en: My younger brother does judo every week.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 習う to the auxiliary いる to form 習っている, which here expresses a habitual and continuous action.

items.jp: このパンは硬くて食べにくいです

translation.pt-BR: Este pão está duro e difícil de comer.
translation.en: This bread is hard and tough to eat.

items.label: conjunction (adjective て-form)
items.explanation: て here is part of 硬くて, the て-form of 硬い. It links two characteristics of the bread: 'it is hard and (therefore/also) hard to eat'.

items.jp: 冷蔵庫に何も入っていません

translation.pt-BR: Não tem nada na geladeira.
translation.en: There's nothing in the fridge.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 入る to the auxiliary いる to form 入っている, the construction that expresses a continuous state ('to be inside').
tokens: indefinite pronoun (subject of what there isn't)

items.jp: シャツを何枚持っているの

translation.pt-BR: Quantas camisas você tem?
translation.en: How many shirts do you have?

items.label: connective particle of the te-form
items.explanation: て links 持っ to the auxiliary いる, forming the aspect 〜ている (continuous state of possession).

items.jp: 額に手を当ててみた

translation.pt-BR: Eu experimentei pôr a mão na testa.
translation.en: I tried putting my hand on my forehead.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て liga 当てる ao que vem depois (みる) e encadeia os dois dentro da mesma frase.

items.jp: 新しい技術を勉強しています

translation.pt-BR: Estou estudando uma tecnologia nova.
translation.en: I'm studying a new technology.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links 勉強する to the auxiliary いる, forming 〜ている, which expresses an ongoing action.
tokens: nominal core of the compound verb 勉強する

items.jp: 糸が切れてしまった

translation.pt-BR: O fio acabou arrebentando.
translation.en: The thread ended up snapping.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 切れる to the auxiliary しまう, forming the construction 〜てしまう. It is this link that allows the nuance of 'ending up happening / being completed' to be added to the verb.
tokens: auxiliary (補助動詞) of the 〜てしまう construction

items.jp: 荷物の重さを量ってください

translation.pt-BR: Pese a bagagem, por favor.
translation.en: Please weigh the luggage.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: The て links 量る to ください, forming the request 〜てください ('please weigh it').

items.jp: この手紙を友達に届けてください

translation.pt-BR: Por favor, entregue esta carta ao seu amigo.
translation.en: Please give this letter to your friend.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 届ける to ください, forming the request pattern 〜てください ('please do').

items.jp: 夜空に星が光っている

translation.pt-BR: As estrelas estão brilhando no céu noturno.
translation.en: The stars are shining in the night sky.

items.label: connective particle (te-form of the verb)
items.explanation: て links 光る to the auxiliary いる, creating the construction 〜ている that indicates continuous action ('to be shining').

items.jp: 薄いコートを着ている

translation.pt-BR: Estou usando um casaco fino.
translation.en: I'm wearing a thin coat.

items.label: conjunction (て-form)
items.explanation: This て turns 着る into 着て to link to the auxiliary いる, forming the continuous aspect 着ている.

items.jp: 彼は今シャワーを浴びているところだ

translation.pt-BR: Ele está tomando banho agora.
translation.en: He's taking a shower right now.

items.label: connector of the て-form (links verb + auxiliary いる)
items.explanation: This て links 浴び to いる, forming 浴びている ('to be showering'), the action in progress that ところだ highlights.
tokens: formal noun (head of ところだ)

items.jp: 店員が商品を取り替えてくれた

translation.pt-BR: O atendente trocou o produto para mim.
translation.en: The clerk exchanged the product for me.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 取り替え to the auxiliary くれる, forming 〜てくれる ('someone does something for my benefit').

items.jp: 服が泥で汚れてしまった

translation.pt-BR: A roupa acabou ficando toda suja de lama.
translation.en: My clothes ended up all covered in mud.

items.label: connective particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 汚れる to the auxiliary しまう, forming the construction 〜てしまう that expresses completion of the action.

items.jp: 旅行が楽しくなるように祈っている

translation.pt-BR: Estou torcendo para que a viagem seja divertida.
translation.en: I'm hoping the trip will be fun.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 祈って to the auxiliary いる, forming the progressive 〜ている ('I am rooting/hoping').

items.jp: 暑くてたまらない

translation.pt-BR: Está um calor insuportável.
translation.en: It's unbearably hot.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て liga 暑い ao que vem depois (たまる) e encadeia os dois dentro da mesma frase.

items.jp: この国は米を輸出している

translation.pt-BR: Este país exporta arroz.
translation.en: This country exports rice.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links し to いる to form している, which indicates a habitual or ongoing action.
tokens: verbal object (forms the verb 輸出する)

items.jp: 鳥が木の枝に止まっている

translation.pt-BR: Um pássaro está pousado no galho da árvore.
translation.en: A bird is perched on the tree branch.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 止まる to the auxiliary いる to form 〜ている, expressing the continuous state.

items.jp: それは法律で決まっています

translation.pt-BR: Isso é determinado por lei.
translation.en: That is determined by law.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 決まっ to the auxiliary いる to form 〜ている, which here marks an already-established state.

items.jp: 子供の手が汚れています

translation.pt-BR: As mãos da criança estão sujas.
translation.en: The child's hands are dirty.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 汚れ to the auxiliary いる, forming the construction ている that expresses a continuous state/aspect.

items.jp: 教室の隅に立っていた

translation.pt-BR: Estava parado no canto da sala de aula.
translation.en: I was standing in the corner of the classroom.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 立つ to the auxiliary いる, creating the construction 〜ている which expresses a continuous state.

items.jp: 紙の裏に名前を書いてください

translation.pt-BR: Escreva seu nome no verso do papel, por favor.
translation.en: Please write your name on the back of the paper.

items.label: connective particle of the て-form (て)
items.explanation: Turns 書く into 書いて, linking the verb to ください to build the request 'please write'.

items.jp: 今日は朝から曇っています

translation.pt-BR: Hoje está nublado desde cedo.
translation.en: It's been cloudy since this morning.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 曇っ to the auxiliary います, forming the continuous construction 〜ている.

items.jp: 各国の料理を食べてみたい

translation.pt-BR: Quero experimentar a comida de cada país.
translation.en: I want to try the food of each country.

items.label: conjunctive particle (て-form)
items.explanation: て links 食べる to the auxiliary みる, forming the construction 〜てみる ('to try doing').

items.jp: ここでバスに乗り換えてください

translation.pt-BR: Baldeie para o ônibus aqui, por favor.
translation.en: Please transfer to the bus here.

items.label: connective particle of the te-form (て)
items.explanation: Links the verb 乗り換え to the auxiliary ください, forming the polite request 乗り換えてください.

items.jp: このケーキは甘くておいしい

translation.pt-BR: Este bolo é doce e gostoso.
translation.en: This cake is sweet and delicious.

items.label: conjunctive particle (て-form)
items.explanation: て is the suffix that forms the て-form of the adjective (甘く+て). It links 甘い to the following adjective with the sense of 'and', enumerating qualities.

items.jp: 父は貿易の会社で働いています

translation.pt-BR: Meu pai trabalha numa empresa de comércio exterior.
translation.en: My father works at a foreign trade company.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 働い to the auxiliary いる to form 〜ている, expressing the continuous state of working.

items.jp: 明日晴れるように祈っています

translation.pt-BR: Estou torcendo para fazer sol amanhã.
translation.en: I'm hoping it'll be sunny tomorrow.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links 祈っ to the auxiliary いる to form 〜ている ('to be praying'), expressing the action as ongoing/current state.
tokens: core of the ように construction
auxiliary of the ように construction

items.jp: ビールが温くなってしまった

translation.pt-BR: A cerveja acabou esquentando.
translation.en: The beer ended up getting warm (it lost its chill).

items.label: connective particle of the て-form (て)
items.explanation: Links the verb なって to the auxiliary しまう, forming the pattern 〜てしまう ('to end up ~').

items.jp: 猫が軒の下で寝ている

translation.pt-BR: O gato está dormindo embaixo do beiral.
translation.en: The cat is sleeping under the eaves.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 寝る to the auxiliary いる; it is the junction that creates the progressive form 寝ている ('to be sleeping').

items.jp: この頃少し疲れている

translation.pt-BR: Ultimamente estou um pouco cansado.
translation.en: I've been a little tired lately.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: The て links 疲れ to the auxiliary いる, forming 〜ている, which expresses the continuous state of being tired.

items.jp: 講堂に学生が集まっている

translation.pt-BR: Os alunos estão reunidos no auditório.
translation.en: The students are gathered in the auditorium.

items.label: verbal conjunction (て-form)
items.explanation: て links 集まっ to the auxiliary いる to form 〜ている; it is the connective particle that allows expressing the continuous/resultative aspect.

items.jp: 問題が複雑化してしまった

translation.pt-BR: O problema acabou ficando complicado.
translation.en: The problem ended up getting complicated.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links the main verb し (する) to the auxiliary しまう, forming 〜てしまった ('to end up doing / to end up happening').
tokens: noun forming the compound verb (複雑化する)

items.jp: この町は古いお寺の一つで知られている

translation.pt-BR: Essa cidade é conhecida por ter um dos templos antigos.
translation.en: This town is known for having one of the old temples.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 知られ to the auxiliary いる, forming 知られている (the continuous state of 'being known').

items.jp: 花屋が花束を家まで届けてくれた

translation.pt-BR: A floricultura entregou o buquê na minha casa.
translation.en: The flower shop delivered the bouquet to my house.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 届ける to the auxiliary くれる, forming 届けてくれた ('delivered for me'), expressing the benefit received.

items.jp: パンが黒く焼けてしまった

translation.pt-BR: O pão acabou queimando.
translation.en: The bread ended up getting burnt.

items.label: verbal connector (te-form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 焼ける to the auxiliary しまう, forming the construction 〜てしまう, which indicates that the action was completed in a regrettable way.

items.jp: 彼は復習に時間をたっぷり使っています

translation.pt-BR: Ele dedica bastante tempo à revisão.
translation.en: He spends a lot of time reviewing.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て connects 使う to the auxiliary いる, forming 使っている (continuous/habitual aspect).

items.jp: 心臓に毛がビッシリ生えている

translation.pt-BR: Ele tem sangue de barata.
translation.en: You have nerves of steel.

items.label: connective particle (て)
items.explanation: Links 生え to いる to form 生えている, indicating a continuous/resultant state (something that grew and remains so).

items.jp: 彼は父を尊敬している。

translation.pt-BR: Ele admira o pai.
translation.en: He respects his father.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て liga する ao que vem depois (いる) e encadeia os dois dentro da mesma frase.

items.jp: 彼は農業の研究をしている。

items.label: connective particle (て form)

items.jp: このジャムの瓶、ふたが固くて開かないよ。

translation.en: This jam jar's lid is stuck and won't open.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て (attached to 固く) links the adjective 固い to the following clause, expressing cause: 'it is stuck, AND (therefore) won't open.'
